create_nvcf_training_job: create an NVCF training job by submitting a payload and starting a background polling thread
submit_nvcf_job_request: submit an NVCF job request via POST to the NVIDIA DGX API with auth token and payload
poll_nvcf_job_status: poll an NVCF job status endpoint at intervals until completion or timeout is reached
convert_dict_to_object: recursively convert a nested dictionary into a SimpleNamespace object for attribute-style access
review_nvcf_runner_class: review the NVCFRunner class methods for submitting and polling NVIDIA NVCF training jobs
